title: RRB Section Controller Exam Date 2026 – Out
vacancyDetails: Section Controller posts in Indian Railways as per RRB CEN 03/2026 vacancy distribution.
qualification: Candidates must be a Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university.
ageLimit: Minimum Age : 20 Years, Maximum Age : 33 Years as on 01 July 2026. Age relaxation is available as per RRB rules.
applicationFee: General / OBC / EWS : ₹500/-, SC / ST / EBC / All Category female : ₹250/-. UR / OBC / EWS fee refund ₹400/-; SC / ST / PH & Female refund ₹250/- after CBT-I. Pay through debit card, credit card, internet banking, IMPS, cash card or mobile wallet.
selectionProcess: CBT → CBAT → Document Verification → Medical Examination
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, photo ID, passport photos, signature, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.rrbapply.gov.in
2. Open Section Controller CEN apply online
3. Register and fill preferences for RRBs
4. Upload documents and pay fee
5. Submit before last date
shortDescription: RRB Section Controller Exam Date 2026 is announced. The examination is scheduled on 12-13 October 2026 and the application last date was 14 August 2026.
content:
Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the exam date notice for the recruitment of the Section Controller Examination 2026 under CEN 03/2026.

The exam is scheduled for 12 – 13 October 2026. The application form was accepted from 15 July 2026 to 14 August 2026 and fee payment continued till 16 August 2026. Candidates must check their exam date and city details through the official RRB portal using registration number or date of birth.

Important Dates

  • Online Apply Start Date: 15 July 2026
  • Online Apply Last Date: 14 August 2026 (23:59 PM)
  • Last Date For Fee Payment: 16 August 2026
  • Correction Date: 17 – 26 August 2026
  • Exam Date: 12 – 13 October 2026
  • Admit Card: Before Exam
  • Result Date: Will Be Updated Here Soon

The application fee is ₹500 for General / OBC / EWS candidates and ₹250 for SC / ST / EBC / female candidates. The examination process includes CBT, CBAT, document verification and medical examination.
